This easy Indian vegetarian breakfast is made with rolled oats, green moong dal, and fresh vegetables, making it rich in protein, fiber, and essential nutrients.
This less oil, no maida breakfast recipe is ideal for weight loss, kids' tiffin box, and a healthy lifestyle. It keeps you full for a longer time and helps in managing weight naturally.
